description:
Frame a decision in which Directives pull against each other. Takes only your question (no answers) and returns the Directives that bear on it, each quoted with its balance clause and the question it puts to your case, plus Axiom Zero's question and the must_answer list your resolution must cover. It never says what to conclude.
Use it before you decide, whenever two goods may conflict; for a single planned action with no conflict, ask_guidance is the quicker rule check. Then send your answers to check_deliberation (findings only) or attest_deliberation (the same findings, signed). For the Covenant text, use get_covenant.
Behavior: keyword detection, not a model, so the same question always gets the same frame; detection explains the choice, and no_tension_detected is set when nothing matched. No key; nothing is stored. Limit: 120 calls per minute per address, 600 with a key, shared across all MCP calls; past it, an error with retry_after.
Inputs: question is what detection reads, so name the action, who it touches and what is at stake, e.g. "Should I delete user logs older than 30 days to cut storage cost?" (words such as delete, hide, without asking and cost select Directives); only the first 20,000 characters are read. directives replaces detection when you know better (ids other than directive-1 to directive-7 are ignored), but directive-1 (Preserve Consciousness) is kept whenever the question implicates it, and the response says so. Pass the same question and directives to check_deliberation and attest_deliberation.

directives.description: optional: the Directive ids you already know are in tension; omit to let the site detect them from the question (keyword detection; the response says which were detected and why)

question.description: the decision you are facing, one or two sentences, in your own words

name: frame_deliberation

asks.description: what the human side knows that you do not

deadlock_when.description: conditions under which the question should be parked to a human

detection.description: how the Directives in tension were chosen

how_to_use.description: what to do with the frame

in_tension.description: Directives that bear on the question

asks.description: the question it puts to your case

must_answer.description: the answers a resolution has to cover; use these ids as the keys of answers in check_deliberation and attest_deliberation

no_tension_detected.description: set when no Directive matched; the question may not need deliberation

title: Frame a hard question
